tie_policy: An exact logit tie counts as half correct.
selection: Fixed edit. Calibration maximizes balanced development accuracy, with smallest absolute bias breaking ties.
recommendation: Explore replication only if held-out gain is positive, beats calibration and random 95th percentile, has a positive paired bootstrap lower bound, and regression mean log-probability change is at least -0.05 nats. This regression tolerance is a chosen exploratory threshold.
claim: A fixed den-minus-det output-row direction transfers to min-minus-mitt agreement on unseen definite Swedish nouns.
